breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the distributed-load case with its midspan resultant when computing deflection, but an equivalent resultant does not preserve beam deflection behavior.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly instructs to use the standard formula for a uniformly distributed load over the full span, rather than replacing the distributed load with its resultant at midspan. This aligns with the ground truth and avoids the incorrect approach of substituting a single resultant force for the UDL.
